newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 2.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Funds flow into mainland China from Taiwan to be subjected to tough scrutiny.
U.S. house speaker Newt Gingrich says "one China" policy cannot be implemented by force.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui opposes abolition of Taiwan's Tibetan and Mongolian Commission.
Gingrich says U.S. will defend Taiwan from communist Chinese attack.
LIBERTY TIMES - Newt Gingrich to meet President Lee Teng-hui.
National Assembly to start revising constitution.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan share prices rise despite falls in other markets worldwide.
Workers from same industries can form labour unions.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Direct (Taiwan-China) shipping links expected to start by mid-April.
Banks check funding sources of Taiwan companies with investment in mainland China.
